title: Sonam Wangchuk Claims "House Arrest" Amid Planned Ladakh Protest

ai.summary: A protest movement in Ladakh is planning demonstrations amid claims by Sonam Wangchuk that he is under house arrest.

facts.claim: Sonam Wangchuk claims he is under house arrest
facts.quote: Sonam Wangchuk Claims "House Arrest" Amid Planned Ladakh Protest

ai.background_note: Ladakh, a union territory without a legislature since 2019, wants the same protections as tribal areas in four north-eastern states under the Sixth Schedule.
